subject: Re: Request: temporary SLO carveout & remedy cap for ApexCloud pilot
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <sgupta@apexcloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Martinez <emartinez@apexcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot ask — temporary SLO carveout and remedy cap

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we had strong interest from our platform team. We are getting internal approval to start a constrained pilot (3 months) but procurement has asked for two concessions before we can sign:

- Temporary uptime SLO: relax from 99.95% to 99.90% for the pilot period.
- Remedy cap: cap service credits at 5% of monthly invoice (rather than the standard unlimited exposure tied to uptime).

We understand these are non-standard; this is a short-term pilot and we can revert to standard SLOs for production. I attached a short proposal (apex_slo_proposal_v1.pdf) and the security questionnaire they asked for. Can you loop in whoever needs to approve an exception?

Desired timeline: contract signed by 6/9 so pilot starts mid-June.

Best,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Platform Partnerships
ApexCloud
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <sgupta@apexcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — temporary SLO carveout and remedy cap

Samir — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Looping in Marissa (AE) and Ben (Deal Desk) so we can get a commercial view and see what approval path is required.

Ben / Marissa — ApexCloud is asking for a pilot carveout: 99.90% uptime for three months and cap service credits to 5% monthly. They want to sign by 6/9. Samir attached their proposal and the security questionnaire.

Jonas
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — temporary SLO carveout and remedy cap

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick commercial notes:
- Pilot discount: they're requesting a 30% pilot discount in the draft — that's negotiable but impacts revenue recognition.
- SLO carveout: lowering to 99.90% materially increases risk exposure for production customers if we make it policy; for a constrained pilot we can consider a time-boxed exception if exec approves.
- Remedy cap: 5% cap on credits is more favorable to us than uncapped exposure, but we should define qualifying incidents and measurement windows.

I'm preparing a short counter (attached: redwood_slo_counter_20270602.pdf) that keeps standard monitoring and defines a single aggregated incident window for the pilot. Need final signoff from Deal Desk + Finance (looping Karthik).

Ben
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <sgupta@apexcloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — temporary SLO carveout & remedy cap

Samir — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Two operational asks from our side so internal teams are comfortable:
1) Pilot must run in a dedicated tenant (logical isolation) to limit blast radius.
2) We require weekly syncs during the pilot to closely monitor error/latency patterns.

If those operational items are acceptable, we can push the deal towards a time-boxed SLO exception. Ben / Karthik — does Finance need anything else to approve the 5% cap?

-Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 14:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — finance view on remedy cap

Quick finance take:
- 5% monthly cap on credits for a three-month pilot is acceptable if we secure a minimum monthly commitment for the pilot (min billable $25k/mo). Without a commit the cap exposes us.
- Need clear termination/rollback language: automatic revert to standard SLOs at pilot end and no retrospective credits beyond pilot period.

If Ben confirms the minimum commit, I can greenlight the cap.

Karthik
Head of Commercial Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Gupta <sgupta@apexcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot ask — final recommendation for exec approval

Samir / ApexTeam — we appreciate the urgency. Internal recommendation:
- Approve a time-boxed SLO carveout to 99.90% for 90 days, effective on contract signature.
- Remedy cap set at 5% monthly of the pilot invoice but only if Apex commits to a minimum $25k/mo for the pilot.
- Pilot must run in dedicated tenant and include weekly operational syncs.
- SLO and remedy revert to standard terms at the end of the pilot automatically; no retrospective make-whole beyond the pilot.

For exec approval: Ben to request formal signoff from the Revenue Ops exec (Marissa to route to VP or CFO depending on the commit). Samir — can you confirm the monthly commit and we will route for final authorization and sign the contract?

Attachments referenced: redwood_slo_counter_20270602.pdf, apex_slo_proposal_v1.pdf

Ben Carter
Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
